state.project: CC - Garrett Road Switching Station - Trae Lane
state.description: Build the new Garrett Road 230kV switching station (three - element ring bus) splitting the Villa Rica - West Marietta 230kV line. Build a new 230kV line (8.6 miles) from the Trae Lane substation to the Garrett Road switching station with bundled 100C 1351 ACSR conductor.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
